q18.

The `store.Driver` interface is declared in `store/driver.go`, and it has three implementations, each with its own package entry file defining `NewDB(profile) (store.Driver, error)`:

- `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go`
- `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`
- `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`

`NewDBDriver` — `store/db/db.go`

It switches on `profile.Driver` (`"sqlite"`, `"mysql"`, `"postgres"`, erroring with "unknown db driver" otherwise) and is called at startup from `cmd/memos/main.go:57`.
